title: Claims Manual: Deciding KestrelCare Repair Authorization Requests
content:
## A. Authorization and one decision per repair order

A repair facility requests authorization before starting work, and each repair order is decided once. Whether a repair order has already been decided is read from the KestrelCare plan's own history: a repair order number that already carries a claim decision entry on the plan is not decided a second time.

## B. Order of the tests

The decision on a KestrelCare Vehicle Service Contracts repair order follows this order; the first test that applies gives the decision.

| Test | The failure | Decision |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | has a failure date before the coverage start date, or a repair-order odometer below the coverage start odometer | denied: waiting period |
| 2 | occurs while the plan is cancelled, expired, exhausted or transferred at the failure date, or after the expiration date, or at or above the expiration odometer | denied: contract not in force |
| 3 | is on a failed part outside the plan's covered components (for a hybrid or EV traction battery, one above the plan's battery capacity threshold) | denied: not a covered component |
| 4 | is on a vehicle in commercial use, or is a condition documented on the purchase inspection or before the sale date | denied: pre-existing condition |
| 5 | is a claim on a maintenance record component without proof that manufacturer-scheduled maintenance was done within the tolerance | denied: maintenance records |

The clause that closed the order of tests reads: "Otherwise the claim is approved: the estimate is recognized at no more than the plan's labor rate cap, diagnostic time only when the plan covers it, the deductible is applied once per visit unless waived at a Kestrel network facility, and the amount payable is the lesser of the recognized estimate less the deductible, the plan's per-visit limit and the coverage remaining." That clause is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis for KestrelCare authorizations and payments.

*Boundary points (hypothetical plan with coverage start odometer 42200 and expiration odometer 90000):* a repair order at 42199 miles fails test 1; at 42200 it passes test 1. A repair order at 89999 miles passes test 2 on mileage; at 90000 it fails test 2.

## C. Payment, recovery and facility timing

- A claim is paid only on a plan whose status is active, as the service contract record shows it.
- The clause "A payment found to have been made in error within the payment recovery window is recovered and the limit restored." is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis for recovering claim payments made in error.
- Facilities are paid within the facility payment business days of the plan.

superseded_clauses: Otherwise the claim is approved: the estimate is recognized at no more than the plan's labor rate cap, diagnostic time only when the plan covers it, the deductible is applied once per visit unless waived at a Kestrel network facility, and the amount payable is the lesser of the recognized estimate less the deductible, the plan's per-visit limit and the coverage remaining.
A payment found to have been made in error within the payment recovery window is recovered and the limit restored.
